agent_explanation: High-speed (40.89 m/s horizontal) large-radius (1.186) body approaches thin vertical wall (w=0.1 at x=10.6). At step 9 distance to wall is +0.268 (already near), then at step 10 distance becomes -0.388 exceeding limit 0.15. Substeps (22 per step) insufficient for speed/wall-thickness ratio, and collision occurs near bottom corner of wall (wall bottom y=2.1, body y~1.86 below wall bottom, grazing corner) where positional correction/impulse fails to prevent penetration. Counterfactual reducing vx to 10 removes penetration, confirming velocity/thin-wall interaction is causal.
